name: OpenClaw Factorio Runtime
description: Installs a bundled Factorio runtime API mod and exposes safe local RCON tools for live game inspection/control.

host.label: RCON Host
host.help: Local Factorio RCON host. Keep this on localhost for single-player/local games.

password.label: RCON Password
password.help: Optional override. Prefer running `openclaw factorio setup`, which stores a generated password locally.

requireConfirmationForMutatingActions.label: Require confirmation for mutating actions
requireConfirmationForMutatingActions.help: Default true. Set false only if you want agents to craft/place/move/mine/destroy/give/remove without per-action confirmation.

allowMutationsWithoutConfirmation.label: Allow mutations without confirmation
allowMutationsWithoutConfirmation.help: Dangerous opt-in alias. Keep false unless this Factorio save is safe for autonomous actions.

requireConfirmationForMutatingActions.description: When false, factorio_runtime mutating actions do not require confirmed=true.
